title: ENFORCEMENT DECREE OF THE PROVISIONAL ACT ON SPECIAL CASES CONCERNING THE TREATMENT OF CONFISCATED VALUABLES, ETC.
full_text:
Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Decree is to prescribe matters necessary for the enforcement of the Act on Temporary Special Cases concerning the Treatment of Confiscated Valuables (hereinafter referred to as the "Act").

Article 2 (Notification by prosecutors of any level) When there are confiscated valuables under Article 2 of the Act, the Prosecutor General, the Superintending Prosecutor of a High Prosecutors’ Office, the Superintending Prosecutor of a district prosecutors' office, the chief of the Ministry of National Defense Prosecutor's Office, and the head of the military prosecutors office of each military branch (hereinafter referred to as "Superintending Prosecutors of any level") shall notify the Director of the National Intelligence Service thereof without delay in Form 1. <Amended on Mar. 31, 1999; Jun. 30, 2022>

Article 3 (Request for transmittal by Director of the National Intelligence Service) (1) Where the Director of the National Intelligence Service deems that any confiscated valuables notified pursuant to the preceding Article need to be directly used or disposed of pursuant to Article 3(1) of the Act, the Director shall request the relevant Superintending Prosecutor of any level to transmit such valuables within 30 days from the date of receipt of the notification, using Form 2. <Amended on Mar. 31, 1999>
  (2) Even where the Director of the National Intelligence Service deems that none of the confiscated valuables notified are to be directly used or disposed of, the Director shall notify the relevant Superintending Prosecutor of any level of to that effect within the period prescribed in paragraph (1). <Amended on Mar. 31, 1999>
  [Title Amended on Mar. 31, 1999]

Article 4 (Transmittal of confiscated valuables) Upon receipt of a request for the transmittal of confiscated valuables pursuant to Article 3(1), the relevant Superintending Prosecutor of any level shall transmit the valuables to the Director of the National Intelligence Service within 10 days from the date of receipt of the request. <Amended on Mar. 31, 1999>

Article 5 (Approval of the President) (1) Where the Director of the National Intelligence Service intends to obtain the approval of the President under Article 3(1) of the Act, the Director shall submit a written request stating the following matters: <Amended on Mar. 31, 1999>
  1. The purpose of and necessity for the direct use or disposal;
  2. The description and quantity of the valuables.
  (2) Where, after obtaining the approval of the President pursuant to paragraph (1), the Director of the National Intelligence Service intends to change the purpose for which the confiscated valuables are to be used or disposed of, the procedure for obtaining such approval shall be governed by paragraph (1).

Article 6 (Return) Where the Director of the National Intelligence Service fails to obtain the approval of the President pursuant to Article 3(1) of the Act with respect to the valuables transmitted pursuant to Article 4, or deems, after obtaining such approval, that the use or disposal of the valuables is no longer necessary, the Director shall return the valuables to the Superintending Prosecutor of any level that transmitted them within 15 days from that time. <Amended on Mar. 31, 1999>

Article 7 (Payment into the National Treasury) Payment into the National Treasury pursuant to Article 3(2) of the Act shall be made by disbursing the amount to be paid from the annual expenditure budget of the National Intelligence Service and paying the amount into the National Treasury. <Amended on Mar. 31, 1999>
